mapper.select: select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , '부산' as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '사용가능' and coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(cs.is_deleted, false) = false and ( cs.address like '부산%' or cs.address like '부산광역시%' or cs.address ilike '%Busan%' ) order by random() limit 1
mapper.update: update charger set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where charger_id = #{chargerId}
update charger set status = '사용가능', updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where status = '고장'
mapper.select: select count(*) from charger where status = '고장'

select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , case when cs.address like '부산%' then '부산' else split_part(cs.address, ' ', 1) end as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '고장' order by coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at) desc limit 5
